title: EAOA AGM Wednesday 19th June 2024
text:
The East Anglian Orienteering Association (EAOA) are hosting their annual general meeting this Wednesday 19th June 2024 at 7:30pm online. Orienteering club members across East Anglia are welcome to attend and should contact the EAOA Chair Peter Woods at peterwaocwoods@gmail.com for the zoom meeting link.

The agenda for the meeting is as follows:

1. Apologies for Absence

2. Approval of Minutes of 2023 AGM

3. Matters Arising

4. Motion: That the capitation fee charged to member clubs of the association shall be set to zero, for the current financial year 2024. This shall be reviewed annually

5. Motion: That the AGM approve the revised rules on eligibility for the EA Championship and EA Leagues

5. Chairman’s Report

6. Treasurer’s Report

7. Election of officers – Chair, Treasurer, Secretary

8. Any Other Business
